translations.web: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
translations.bsb: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
translations.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
